**Subject: Lotus Glow Nails — We Are Okay, We Are Coming Back, See You Monday Nov 16!**

Dear friends, neighbors, church family, and my ladies who have been with me all these years,

Last night around 2 a.m., a car drove straight through the front window of my salon, Lotus Glow Nails on Bellaire Blvd. The front glass is gone and my pedicure chair is smashed. Nobody was inside, the driver is okay, and the police came. Her insurance is paying. The city inspector still has to check the wall before I can open the door, but my contractor says we can reopen Monday, November 16.

Until then, this week me, Trang, and Kim will be working at my cousin Hoa's salon, **Pearland Nail Bar**. Please come find us there! Call or text my cell any time: **832-555-0147**. We will take care of your nails the same way we always have.

Two things I want you to know:

- **Your gift cards are still good.** Nobody loses any money. Just bring your card and use it this week.
- **I am okay.** I cried a little in the morning, but I am fine now. God protected my shop because nobody was inside at 2 a.m.

Now, because I have to laugh or I will really cry:

The floor looked like a rainbow throw-up. My husband looked at it and said, "Finally, the shop is modern art." The car stopped exactly at the pedicure chair, like she wanted a spa. My daughter said, "Mom, she got the first drive-thru pedicure in Houston."

Thank you for all the texts, the calls, the food, and the prayers. Mrs. Dung, the pho you brought me this morning was so good — you are feeding me better than I feed my customers! Thank you, everybody. My phone has not stopped ringing and my heart is full.

So: **closed this week at Bellaire Blvd, open Monday, November 16.** Find us at Pearland Nail Bar this week, and come home to Lotus Glow after that.

God bless you all.

Love,
[Your Name]
Lotus Glow Nails — Bellaire Blvd
Cell: 832-555-0147
